title: Signup email link arrives and signs you in
instructions: Go to /start and sign up with a real inbox you control (e.g. you+test@gmail.com). The sign-in email should arrive within a minute; clicking it should land on onboarding. Afterwards, delete the test account's workspace from /admin/modules.

title: Stripe Connect onboarding completes
instructions: In a test workspace: Billing → Connect Stripe. Finish Stripe's hosted onboarding (test mode). Back on Billing it should say "Payments are on".

title: Google consent screen shows the VisionWorkx name and both permissions
instructions: In a test workspace: Settings → Connect Google Calendar with your own account. The screen should name VisionWorkx (not revalorllc.com) and list exactly two calendar permissions. Then Disconnect (only on your own test workspace — never on Revalor QA Calendar).

title: Disconnect removes access in the Google Account
instructions: After disconnecting your own test connection, check myaccount.google.com → Security → Third-party connections: VisionWorkx should no longer be listed.

title: 24-hour reminder email arrives
instructions: Book a time about 25 hours ahead with your real email. The next day, the reminder should arrive about 24 hours before, with a working change/cancel link.

title: Assessment, plan, proposal and client link work end to end
instructions: In /admin/needs-analyzer: + New assessment, fill a few sections, check the Build plan and Proposal update. Proposal → Turn on link, open it in a private window (proposal only, no internal notes), then Turn off and confirm the link now shows 404. Delete the test assessment afterwards.

title: Website check reports a real site and starts an assessment from it
instructions: In /admin/needs-analyzer → Website check, check a real small-business site. The report should show the platform, what the site can and can't do, problems and modules that fit within about a minute. Try localhost or 169.254.169.254: it must refuse. Click Start assessment from this: the questionnaire opens with website, platform and Website observations filled in. Delete the test assessment afterwards.

title: Ticked website problems appear on the client proposal
instructions: On an assessment with a website check: open the check, tick two problems. The assessment's Proposal tab and its client link both show 'What we found on <site>' with exactly those two. Untick them and the section disappears.

title: AI review of a checked website
instructions: On a website check, click Run AI review. Within ~30 seconds it shows a summary, services, message clarity, calls to action, weak spots and talking points. It costs about 1 cent (logged in AI Usage as needs_analyzer_site_review).
